name: @agntux-build/agntux-docusign-view-tool
description: View-tool library module for agntux-docusign. Loaded server-side by the remote MCP registry; not invoked locally.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && for f in *.html; do [ -e "$f" ] || { echo "agntux-build: no view *.html found — author at least one <name>.html before building"; exit 1; }; VITE_ENTRY="${f%.html}" vite build --emptyOutDir=false; done && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/agntux-docusign-view.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/agntux-docusign-view.js --external:@agntux/plugin-runtime && node scripts/emit-manifest.mjs
